description: Allowlisted tools for the verl tuning agents

skills.name: parameter_understanding
skills.description: Query curated verl parameter semantics, memory/throughput effects, interactions, and hard constraints. Query every parameter you intend to change when its effect is uncertain.

items.description: Complete Hydra parameter names to query

skills.name: tuning_strategies
skills.description: Query stage-aware strategies for a measured bottleneck or failure scenario.

skills.name: memory_estimator
skills.description: Estimate rollout, actor-log-prob, ref-log-prob, and training memory from an explicit measured reference trial. The estimator uses a vLLM-budget model for rollout and fixed/model/optimizer/activation components for compute phases. Read projected_pct together with upper_bound_pct, risk, confidence, and uncalibrated_changes; risk is based on the uncertainty upper bound. Pass each change as {"from": reference value, "to": target value}, repeat the target values in parameters, and provide reference_trial_id.

changes.description: Changed Hydra parameters. Every value must contain from (the explicit value in the reference trial, or null if absent) and to (the target value).

from.description: Value in the selected reference trial; use null only when the parameter is absent there

to.description: Candidate target value used by the estimator

parameters.description: Target-value mapping for the same changed parameters, for example {"parameter.name": 0.7}

reference_trial_id.description: Required trial whose parameters and measured phase peaks are the proportional-estimation baseline

skills.name: live_gpu_snapshot
skills.description: Read a safe instantaneous GPU snapshot through nvidia-smi, xpu-smi, or GPU_SMI. This is host occupancy evidence, not phase-specific training memory.

skills.name: search_verl_docs
skills.description: Search bounded local verl 0.7 documentation, config, examples, and worker source for parameter definitions or behavior.

query.description: Parameter name or technical search phrase

skills.name: query_trial_history
skills.description: Query the complete structured trial history with stage/result/failure filters and metric sorting.

skills.name: read_trial_log_excerpt
skills.description: Read a bounded excerpt from a log path already recorded for a trial. No arbitrary path is accepted.
